## 正文

## Summary
- Logs SHA256 hashes of all quantized weight tensors after quantization in lmeval tests, enabling cross-run comparison to isolate quantization differences from evaluation noise
- Logs which `cast_to_fp4` implementation (Triton vs CPU) is active via `ImplBackend` introspection

## Code Review

This pull request adds logging for ImplBackend registered functions and introduces a helper method to log SHA256 hashes of quantized weight tensors from saved .safetensors files. The review feedback suggests optimizing memory usage by avoiding unnecessary data copying when hashing NumPy arrays, and improving robustness by raising an error if no .safetensors files are found.
